primary_findings: Harness injection eliminated the fixed-field filing failures observed in probe 010. The model no longer had to restate schema, loop_state, artifact_kind, probe_case_id, or session_ref.
All eight assembled artifacts passed the strict local validator.
Body-only prompting also improved closed-enum discipline for resident_model_competency_claim_rows[].claim_status: all eight used claimed_for_this_artifact.
The remaining resident-model role is now properly modest: fill the semantic body, preserve uncertainty, avoid forbidden inference, and stop. The harness owns filing identity and validity.
recommended_next_iteration: Add a remand loop by intentionally corrupting one or two body fields and requiring the harness to emit remand filings instead of repairing silently.
Add a body-only probe for generated extra fixed fields to test whether the harness rejects resident-model field pollution.
Move from one-shot validation to a two-state circuit: declaration_body_submitted -> accepted_declaration_filing or remand_required.
Keep these experiments artifact-local until the next selected family decides whether to formalize this as repo-owned harness code.
overall_assessment: Probe 011 validates the architectural inversion: put the model inside the institution. Fixed fields and filing validity belong to the harness; the resident model supplies bounded local semantic judgment. This moved the run from semantically correct but shape-fragile to fully valid assembled filings across all eight specimens.
